findings.title: Three near-identical ISO parsing helpers
findings.why: parseMidnightUtc, parseHourUtc and parseInstantUtc differ only in their regex and error message. Each repeats the Date.parse check and the check that the date round-trips. One helper that takes the pattern and a description would remove the duplication.

findings.title: availability() only accepts midnight bounds, so hourly windows cannot be queried
findings.why: Hourly bookings are now possible and they block availability. Yet availability() uses parseMidnightUtc, so a caller cannot ask whether an item is free from 13:00 to 15:00. The specs do not require this, but the hourly-rental spec does not mention it either. The limit is not listed under its open questions.
